property_summary: For any fuzzed caller, a call to setL1BlockValues succeeds exactly when the caller equals the depositor check target of the reference (address(0), the initial depositorAccount); the mutant instead only admits the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT, so it wrongly reverts when called from address(0).
change_summary: Replace the depositor check against the always-zero state variable with the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT.
